name: Bitwarden Secrets Manager CLI
description: Installs bws, the official Bitwarden Secrets Manager CLI, from bitwarden/sdk-sm GitHub releases. Non-interactive, machine-account-token auth only (BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN) — no vault login, no persisted state, no bind mounts. Also automatically repairs broken host paths in your git config and restores your SSH commit-signing key on every attach.

version.description: Version of bws to install (latest, or a specific version like '2.1.0' or 'bws-v2.1.0')
